name: Rumi Tiered Organza Gown
description: A floor-length gown with three tiers of flowing organza, a square neckline and short puff sleeves. The neckline, sleeves and every tier are edged with a scalloped pearl-white trim, and small white flowers are scattered over the skirt. Fully lined. Made for weddings, holud evenings and festive dinners.

name: Shefali Floral Balloon-Sleeve Dress
description: A midi dress in a retro flower print of pink, yellow and green on cream, with a V-neck, a gathered waist and full balloon sleeves that close at the cuff. Side pockets are hidden in the skirt. Light printed cotton keeps it cool for daytime outings and lunches.

name: Bela Ruffle Collar Tunic
description: A loose, flared tunic top with a wide ruffled collar, a gathered yoke and full sleeves that end in elastic frill cuffs. It falls to the hip and gives full, modest coverage. Pairs well with wide-leg jeans or the Sana Denim Flared Maxi Skirt.

name: Nira Flutter-Sleeve Maxi Dress
description: A floor-length chiffon maxi dress with a square neckline, short layered flutter sleeves and a fitted waist that opens into a full, flowing skirt. Fully lined. An easy choice for parties, dinners and evening events.

name: Tara Bow-Front Tunic
description: A flared tunic top with a large bow at the front, a ruffled cape collar over the shoulders and full balloon sleeves with frill cuffs. The gathered waist falls to the hip for relaxed, modest coverage. Crisp cotton poplin holds the shape of the bow and ruffles.

name: Mira Crochet Daisy Cardigan
description: An open-front crochet cardigan in sage green lace, covered with large pink daisies with yellow centres. Wide bell sleeves and a hip length make it an easy layer over a shirt, a dress or the Lina Polka Dot Maxi Skirt. Hand wash only.

name: Ayra Tiered Maxi and Shrug Set
fabric: Cotton voile dress with a textured cotton shrug
description: A two-piece set: a cream tiered maxi dress in crinkled cotton voile, dotted with small lilac bows, and a cropped lilac shrug with full sleeves, a frilled collar and tie fastenings at the front. Wear them together or separately. Soft and light for everyday wear.

name: Lina Polka Dot Maxi Skirt
description: A high-waisted maxi skirt in white satin crepe with small black polka dots. It falls straight to the ankle and moves easily when walking. A neutral base that pairs with knitwear, shirts and the store's tops. The knit jumper in the photo is not included.

name: Sana Denim Flared Maxi Skirt
description: A high-waisted maxi skirt in mid-wash denim with a button and zip front, front pockets and panelled seams that flare out to a wide raw hem. It reaches the ankle. Pairs with a fitted top, the Bela Ruffle Collar Tunic or the Tara Bow-Front Tunic. The black top in the photo is not included.

name: Kaya Chiffon Midi Dress
description: A midi dress in flowing chiffon with a frilled square neckline, a fitted waistband and sheer three-quarter balloon sleeves gathered into frill cuffs. The full skirt falls to mid-calf. Fully lined. Suited to parties, dinners and evening events.
